articles.summary: Total Revenue Increased 39% YOY to $493 million Royalty Revenue Increased 44% YOY to $341 million Raising 2026 Financial Guidance Ranges: Total Revenue of $1.860 - $1.925 billion, YOY Growth of 33% - 38% Royalty Revenue of $1.235 - $1.255 billion, YOY Growth of 42% - 45% Adjusted EBITDA of $1.240 - $1.290 billion, YOY Growth of 89% - 96% 1 Non-GAAP Diluted EPS of $8.75 - $9.05, YOY Growth of 111% - 118% 1 Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: HALO) ("Halozyme" or the "Company") today reported its financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided an update on its recent corporate activities. "Halozyme delivered another exceptional quarter, with total revenue increasing 39% and royalty revenue growing 44% year-over-year to record levels," said Dr. Helen Torley, President and Chief Executive Officer.
